_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): Tobi at home (hub_tobi): hints.

text.zh_TW: 小托：「里歐！聽說塔裡有隻頂著水桶的史萊姆，自稱騎士耶，超好笑！還有，三層有個害羞的牧羊女，多跟她說幾次話，她就不怕你了。」
text.en: Tobi: "Leo! They say there's a slime in the tower wearing a bucket who calls himself a knight. So funny! Oh, and there's a shy shepherd girl on the third floor. Talk to her a few times and she won't be scared of you."
